description: USAGE FUNCTION-POINTER TO function-prototype-name-1 (§2023:13.18.60.4 GR26 — a function-pointer data item; §2023:8.5.2.7 category function-pointer) — reserved-word evidence dates it 2014 (reserved-words.json FUNCTION-POINTER r2002=false r2014=true). ACTIVE as of kb/Work PB452 + PB817: the FunctionPointer carrier resolves through the ONE RunUnit ProgramTable (ADDRESS OF FUNCTION §2023:8.4.3.12; SET Format 8 §2023:14.9.39.4 GR14; relations §2023:8.8.4.2.16). The TO phrase is MANDATORY — the printed general format (folio 503) brackets POINTER's and PROGRAM-POINTER's operands and not this one — so a bare USAGE FUNCTION-POINTER is COBOL1958. Gate home: the bound-arm UsageConstructId (the usage-program-pointer-2002 pattern).
